confirmed_findings.title: Private render hooks did not propagate cancellation to a stalled native renderer
confirmed_findings.reproduction: Actual render hooks with controlled never-settling Image events. Preference cancellation callback became true but private cancel was never called; 14 images and the promise remained pending. Direct private-renderer cancellation settled correctly. Stylist private rendering had the same inaccessible cancellation boundary.
confirmed_findings.fix: Poll the captured generation or caller cancellation every 50 ms while awaiting the private renderer, invoke its cancel, and clear the interval in finally. Card-book export uses its caller cancellation in the same way.
confirmed_findings.verification: Stalled cancel, healthy completion, native error, exact crop geometry and interval/canvas cleanup tested for preference, stylist and book.

confirmed_findings.title: Changing stylist method allowed a pending result from the old method to publish
confirmed_findings.reproduction: Actual generate/setStylistMode/invalidateRecommendations control flow with a simulated accepted deferred generator result. Research-to-Curated left generation unchanged; the old Research result then rendered and published. This isolates orchestration and does not claim to test engine scoring.
confirmed_findings.fix: Advance the generation and cancel native, visual service and weather work before invalidating recommendations.
confirmed_findings.verification: The current method-change test observes each cancellation and no render/publication after the prior result is released.
